problems: Only one owned state (republic-of-venice, 69 shapes, budget 14 pages). It is one continuous state, not split; Cliopatria runs 705-1796 while the state is 697-1797, so ten new keyframes (697, 1202, 1214, 1358, 1470, 1509, 1517, 1669, 1715, 1797) were added.

The 15th URL opened (War of Ferrara) was a disambiguation page and was replaced by War of Ferrara (1482-1484); the main Republic of Venice article was read twice with different questions and counts as one page.

WebFetch returns a small model's extract, not the page: quotes in notes are the extract's wording; two requests produced sentences the extract said the page does not contain (e.g. the Peace of Lodi is on the History page, not the main page).

74 resolve warnings: 5 are the counterpart slug duchy-of-ferrara (no dossier yet) and 69 are place names the gazetteer lacks (listed in gazetteer_names_needed). The ledger regions for those events will not resolve until the gazetteer agent adds the names.
republic-of-saint-titus is a rebel dossier built from the Kingdom of Candia page alone (wikipedia/wikidata null); the Venice ledger's loss and gain of Crete in 1363/1364/1368 use it as counterpart.

Counterpart slugs used that exist only as Cliopatria rows owned by other groups: byzantine-empire, kingdom-of-hungary, kingdom-of-croatia, republic-of-ragusa, republic-of-genoa, despotate-of-epirus, house-of-anjou-sicily, principality-of-achaea, albanian-principalities, duchy-of-milan, patriarchate-of-aquileia, kingdom-of-cyprus, papal-states, holy-roman-empire, kingdom-of-france, habsburg-monarchy, cisalpine-republic, french-directory, ottoman-empire, latin-empire.
